title: Etale sheaves of sets on a field and discrete Galois sets
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-pc-field-extension], $K^{\rm sep}$ a separable closure [def-kun-separably-closed] embedded in an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $K$, $G=\operatorname{Gal}(K^{\rm sep}/K)$ with its Krull topology, and $\bar s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ the corresponding geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. (i) For a sheaf of sets $F$ on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] of $\operatorname{Spec}K$, the group $G$ acts on the stalk $F_{\bar s}$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] through its action on pointed etale neighbourhoods, and every element of $F_{\bar s}$ has an open stabilizer. The functor $F\mapsto F_{\bar s}$ is an equivalence from the category of sheaves of sets on the small etale site of $\operatorname{Spec}K$ to the category of sets with a $G$-action for which every stabilizer is open. (ii) For an etale $K$-scheme $X$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] in the small etale site, the stalk at $\bar s$ of the sheaf $h_X:U\mapsto\operatorname{Hom}_K(U,X)$ is naturally the $G$-set $\operatorname{Hom}_K(\operatorname{Spec}K^{\rm sep},X)$.

proof.text: Use exists_galoisStalkActionFunctor at coefficient universe max u (v+1), supplying the Ksep-algebra structure on Omega induced by i. This gives a functor T with underlying stalk functor and the canonical formula on germs. Apply galoisStalkActionFunctor_full_faithful and galoisStalkActionFunctor_essSurj to T, then form T.asEquivalence. The given natural isomorphism and germ formula give clause (i).

For every etale X, identify lifts Spec Omega -> X with the stalk of the uliftYoneda sheaf by sending a lift to the germ of id_X. Construct its inverse using the universal property of the stalk colimit, evaluating a representative morphism on its pointed lift. The colimit transition relations prove the two inverse laws. This is the representable-stalk calculation of lem-galois-stalk-representable with an explicit ULift.

Precomposition with Spec i bijects Ksep-points and Omega-points of X: surjectivity is the etale lifting property over a separably closed field, and injectivity is unramified uniqueness. Compose its inverse with the representable-stalk identification. Extend g to an automorphism tau of Omega. The relation tau o i = i o g and the formula on germs show equivariance. For naturality, apply the stalk colimit transition identity to f:X->Y and id_Y. Apply injectivity of both component equivalences to conclude the required equalities of points.
